description: Document library baseline. PRD F-004 requires versioning, draft visibility, content approval and check-out to be set per library according to the approved operating mode (PRD section 4.3).

libraries.title: Controlled Documents
libraries.description: Governed policies, SOPs, work instructions, standards and blank controlled forms across their full lifecycle.

contentApproval.draftVisibilityNote: Approver means only the author and users with Approve Items may see minor versions. This is what keeps drafts invisible to ordinary readers. PRD F-004, A-008.

checkOut.rationale: PRD C-004 and R-04: required check-out blocks co-authoring. It is enabled only where exclusive editing is approved for a specific library, not as a universal DMS setting.

folderCreation.rationale: PRD operating principle 'metadata before folders'. Information architecture is metadata driven.

gridEditing.rationale: Quick-edit bypasses form validation and can set controlled fields directly. PRD F-005.

permissions.uniqueScopes: Only where an approved exception exists. PRD SEC-002, C-006.

libraries.title: Templates
libraries.description: Controlled Word, Excel and PowerPoint templates from which controlled documents are created.

checkOut.rationale: Templates are edited rarely and by few people; exclusive editing prevents concurrent template drift. This is an approved exception to the default.

permissions.rationale: Readers need read access; only Document Control may contribute. Library-level scope, not item-level. PRD C-006.

libraries.title: Operational Records
libraries.description: Completed forms and other evidence of business activity. Captured, not authored.

versioning.rationale: Records are captured complete. Minor versions imply drafting, which does not apply.

contentApproval.rationale: Record capture is not a document approval workflow. Control is applied by retention label and permission, per WF-05.

permissions.rationale: Contribute-only for business users; Records Manager controls retention and disposition; no delete for ordinary users. PRD F-019, F-020.

retention.gate: Blocked from production capture until the retention class is approved. PRD F-018, R-03.

libraries.title: External References
libraries.description: Supplier, customer, legal and standards documents held for reference.
libraries.mvp: P1 unless the pilot needs it. PRD section 10.2.

libraries.title: Published Revisions
libraries.description: Immutable copy of each approved revision, created at activation. Only provisioned if ADR-001 Option B is approved.
libraries.mvp: Decision gate. NOT default MVP. PRD OQ-05, R-20, section 10.2.

versioning.rationale: Each item is a single immutable revision artefact; versioning exists only for correction of a capture defect.

permissions.rationale: Read-only to everyone except the activation service identity. This is what makes the revision immutable in practice.
